findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 1 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 18 questions numbered 1-18; by section: 1.2 1, 1.3 1, 1.4 2, 1.5 1, 1.6 1, 1.7 1, 1.8 2, 1.9 1, 1.10 1, 1.11 2, 1.12 1, 1.13 1, 1.14 1, 1.15 1, 1.16 1.

Covers how data travels and the role of layers, LAN vs WAN with DSL and ISP, the path of data through the networking devices, switch vs router with NIC and MAC, physical vs logical and tree vs star topology, OSI layer comparisons, protocols and HTTP vs HTTPS, an IPv4/IPv6 size calculation, NAT and subnetting, home networks and connection types, Wi-Fi security and router configuration, ping and ipconfig/ifconfig, troubleshooting and remote access, bandwidth, latency and delay, load balancing, security threats and tools, backup and recovery, and the usability-security tradeoff. The exercise's long questions are not repeated. Book correction followed (Figure 1.8: one continuous main cable in a bus topology). 2**32 and 2**128 were checked in Python.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
